title: ProbeAgent: Principled Diagnosis of Agent Failures in Verifiable Environments
abstract: arXiv:2611.26897v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Improving agents requires discovering where they fail and understanding why. An agent acts over multiple steps in a changing environment, so diagnosing its failures requires more than inspecting the final response of a large language model (LLM). The same unsuccessful outcome can arise from task difficulty or from an error the agent repeats across tasks. We introduce ProbeAgent, an automated framework that discovers agent failures, tests their proposed causes, and identifies shared failure modes. Starting from benchmark tasks, ProbeAgent builds executable tests and validates them using reference solutions, automated checks, and review of the task requirements. For each failed trajectory, it explains the error and constructs new tasks that preserve the suspected cause while changing the surrounding context. translated_title: ProbeAgent：可验证环境中智能体失败的原理性诊断
translated_abstract: 改进智能体需要发现它们在哪里失败，并理解失败的原因。智能体在不断变化的环境中执行多步操作，因此诊断其失败不能仅仅依靠检查大语言模型（LLM）的最终响应。同样的不成功结果可能源于任务本身的难度，也可能源于智能体在多个任务中重复犯下的错误。我们提出ProbeAgent，一个自动化框架，用于发现智能体的失败、测试所推测的失败原因，并识别共同的失败模式。从基准任务出发，ProbeAgent构建可执行的测试，并利用参考解答、自动化检查以及对任务需求的审查来验证这些测试。对于每条失败的轨迹，它会解释错误原因，并构建新的任务——这些任务在改变周围上下文的同时保留疑似的原因。在这些任务上运行智能体，可以检验相同的错误是否会再次出现。随后，ProbeAgent将具有相似原因的失败进行分组，并生成……
tldr: ProbeAgent是一个自动化诊断框架，通过构建经过验证的可执行测试、生成保留疑似失败原因的变体任务并观察错误是否复现，来系统性发现、验证并归类智能体的共有失败模式。
en_tdlr: ProbeAgent is an automated framework that systematically discovers, tests, and clusters agent failure modes by building validated executable tests and generating variant tasks that preserve suspected causes to check whether the same error recurs.
